checks: Real SMTP authentication and multipart message use requested Gmail sender/reply address while recipient is the customer
Link in actual SMTP MIME verifies once and grants exactly one credit
SMTP 535 preserves unverified account with zero credits; resend succeeds after credentials recover
Rejected recipient is not reported as a sent email
Saved reading email uses Gmail; a failed delivery preserves the completed article
Silent SMTP greeting is bounded by the configured timeout
Local SMTP override is rejected for public SITE_URL; missing app password leaves email disabled
evidence: Actual Nodemailer SMTP client, auth handlers and isolated SQLite against a loopback SMTP stand-in; no real Gmail calls.
limitations: Does not test Gmail TLS, Google authentication acceptance, network availability from server or inbox delivery.
